name: Amax Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: Amax Holding Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of advanced computing solutions in AI servers and HPC in Asia, the United States, and Europe. The company offers AI data center solutions, such as custom, computing solutions for AI, industrial applications, and cooling technologies; edge AI solutions for AI and server technologies for insights; and liquid cooled solutions, including single-phase cold plate, liquid-to-liquid cooling, immersion cooling, data center cooling, liquidmax workstations, and liquid-to-air cooling. It also provides workstation solutions comprising liquidmax, AR/VR, education, engineering, AI, and media and entertainment; original equipment manufacturing, cooling design,…
